posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Anthony had lost track of time, the arguing over who would go through the portal was ongoing.  Everyone had their own reasons they should be the one to go through and try to stop Blade, only himself, Unity and Fixer were quiet.  Anthony didn't want to be left behind either, to sit here and wait, hoping some catastrophic time changes would catch up and remake his entire life.  Everyone was excited to rewrite history, to set things right and avoid this terrible state, but no one had thought about what would happen to anyone left behind.  The worst possibility was that a new timeline would come into existance, and this world would remain unchanged.  If that happened they would have no way of knowing if the mission had failed or succeeded, and Voss would still be here, furthering his testing, preparing to turn mankind into freakish soldiers for his empire.

The better option was the negation of his entire life.  That was depressing, but better than walking out of these ruins knowing tomorrow would come, dawn on a world with no hope, and only horrors awaiting it.  The people had survived, hoping and waiting for the heroes that would come and stop Voss, and now they had come, and the only hope they had brought was unmaking this world.  What were the people on the surface thinking now, now that as far as they knew all the heroes were dead, and Voss was unopposed.  Downtrodden, desperate, depressed. . .

There was power in desperation, he thought, when people have nothing to lose they won't sit back and wait for someone to help them.  "My god," he thought aloud, "did the stories keep them from fighting back?"  He resolved then and their that he would return, that this group around him could do something, they could lead this planet into war.  Maybe not a war they could win, but a war that would stop Voss from twisting and perverting this planet to his own means.  He stood up, and saw scholar standing in front of him, "Take one."  Anthony pulled a small straw out of Scholar's hand, but he wasn't thinking about that.

"Listen up guys, just because we can't all go back doesn't mean we are finished.  We're not going to sit here and hope that this world stops existing, we're going to go up and make it happen.  We can't defeat Voss and we can't save this planet, but I'll tell you what we can do, no, what we Will do.  We'll make sure that monster doesn't use a single human in his army, we'll rally the people, we'll fight on every front, to the last man, Voss may have won but we will make it his last victory, sap his resources, and die before we can be turned, he'll rue the day he ever came to our planet!"

Everyone was looking at him, and he could tell he had gotten through to them.  But they were all looking at his hand.  He looked down, saw the straw in his hand, then looked at everyone else.  He had the short straw.
